//go:build integration

package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root alone executes this fixture against its migrated disposable database.
// Initial profile/path are named owner API fixtures. Eight named upstream
// official Practice bundles use the real registered legacy evidence contract,
// actual immutable persistence and existing Student mastery reducer. This is
// not a claim of actual upstream Runtime code validation.
func TestT203HybridMasteryOwnerIngress(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("STUDENT_T20_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("root-owned T20 Student PostgreSQL gate absent")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated native T20 Student database required")
	}
	export := os.Getenv("T203_OWNER_EVENT_FILE")
	if export == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: fresh owner event export path required")
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(export); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: export path must be absent")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	studentID, now := uuid.NewString(), time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	profile := studentuc.PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: &postgres.StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Clock: t203OwnerClock{}}
	if _, err := profile.Handle(ctx, studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput{StudentID: studentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "go.backend", PreferredLanguage: "en", WeeklyMinutes: 60, PreferredPace: "standard"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: real initial owner profile: %v", err)
	}
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax-basics", Version: "v1"}
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "named-t203-upstream-initial-course-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Named initial protected work and redundant future fixture", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
	}}
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	path, replay, err := journey.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: real initial owner path: %v", err)
	}
	storedBefore, err := journey.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, path.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: actual persisted path baseline: %v", err)
	}
	before, _ := json.Marshal(storedBefore)
	evidence := &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	token := uuid.NewString()
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(&privatehandlers.Handler{PracticeEvidence: studentuc.ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: evidence}}, token))
	var lastID string
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		lastID = uuid.NewString()
		bundle := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1, PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1, EvidenceID: lastID, SubmissionID: lastID, StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: uuid.NewString(), TaskRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", Evidence: []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: target, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{fmt.Sprintf("named-upstream-runtime-step-%d", i)}}}, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)}
		raw, err := json.Marshal(bundle)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/practice-evidence", strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", lastID)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("official evidence%d ingress status=%d body=%s", i, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	mastery, err := evidence.ListStudentTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, []domain.LearningTargetRef{target})
	if err != nil || len(mastery) != 1 || mastery[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryMastered || mastery[0].Confidence != .8 || mastery[0].EvidenceCount != 8 || mastery[0].IndependentSuccessCount != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("actual existing mastery reducer: %#v %v", mastery, err)
	}
	current, err := journey.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, path.ID)
	after, _ := json.Marshal(current)
	if err != nil || string(before) != string(after) {
		t.Fatalf("evidence or planning fact mutated owner path: before=%s after=%s err=%v", before, after, err)
	}
	var receipts, audits, facts int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_evidence_receipt WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1')`, studentID).Scan(&receipts, &audits, &facts); err != nil || receipts != 8 || audits != 8 || facts != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("official owner durable counts receipts=%d audits=%d facts=%d err=%v", receipts, audits, facts, err)
	}
	var raw []byte
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT payload::text FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject=$2 AND causation_id=$3 AND correlation_id=$4`, studentID, domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, lastID, path.ID).Scan(&raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(export, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual owner event export failed")
	}
	t.Logf("PASS real registered Student official Practice evidence ingress → PG 8 immutable receipts/audits/facts → MASTERED confidence0.80; path version%d unchanged; upstream Runtime bundles named fixtures", current.Version)
}

type t203OwnerClock struct{}

func (t203OwnerClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }
